skill_name: Come up with a strategy to teach an 11-year-old the multiplication table.
workflow: An effective strategy for teaching an 11-year-old the multiplication table would include a combination of visual and hands-on activities. Start by providing printed multiplication charts or flashcards as visuals to practice with. Have the child write out the chart several times a day to reinforce the concept.
